metadata.name: BioDSH

paragraphs.text: The bioinformatics agent desktop for clinicians and wet-lab scientists — built on DeepSeek Harness.
One-click installers, a skill store, offline mode.
**A bioinformatics agent for clinicians and wet-lab scientists. Describe the analysis in plain langu
age and get the result, with no coding.**
中文 · Download · dsh plugin · Results
You add your data (single-cell `h5ad`, count matrices, clinical tables, gene lists…) and ask a quest
ion such as *"Do responders and non-responders differ in CD8A expression?"* The agent loads the data
, picks the right method, writes and runs the code, and reports the conclusion along with the figure
s, the tables and every step it took.
BioDSH runs on your own computer and is built on DeepSeek Harness (dsh). It comes in two forms: a on
e-click **desktop app** and a **dsh plugin** (`dsh-biodsh`).
BioDSH 1.0 skill hub (preview; catalog entries and counts are illustrative). Interactive preview
## Why BioDSH
- **Plain language in, conclusions out.** You don't need to write code or set up an environment. A P
ython analysis environment (scanpy, anndata, pandas, statsmodels, matplotlib…) installs itself on fi

rst launch.
- **Validated methods instead of improvised code.** It ships 17 official analysis skills
: single-cell QC, clustering, annotation and treatment response; bulk RNA-seq with limma-voom; Kapla
n–Meier and Cox survival; regression with robust standard errors; ANOVA designs; and more. The stati
stics skills were checked against R on tens of thousands of cases (for example, 101,587 survival com

parisons with zero mismatches).
- **The right skill picked automatically.** For each request, a mode
l selects the one or two relevant skills from the 17 official skills and a library of 2,000+ communi
ty skills, and loads only those, so the context stays small. Community skills are scanned, and those

that ship benchmark answers are excluded.
- **Frontier-level accuracy from an inexpensive model.**
With DeepSeek V4 Flash, BioDSH matches Claude Code driven by Opus on our 120-task benchmark (102 vs

103) at about a third of the API-equivalent cost (see Results).
- **Long analyses always finish.** A
convergence guard keeps the agent from running in circles. It first asks the agent to wrap up, then

asks for a final answer, so you always get a result.
- **Your data stays safe.** Original files are
never modified, and every analysis writes into a new folder. In offline mode BioDSH talks only to a

model on your own machine or intranet, which suits hospitals and labs.
- **Every result can be trac
ed.** Every step goes into an append-only session log that you can review, export or hand to a revie

wer.
- **Reusable workflows.** You can save a finished analysis as a workflow and rerun it on new da

ta. BioDSH can also build a workflow from an existing script, notebook or methods paragraph.
- **You
r choice of model.** BioDSH works with DeepSeek's official API, any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, or a
local or intranet model, and you can configure several of them side by side.
## Download
| Version | Platform | Get it |

| **1.0.0** (latest) | Windows 10/11 | `BioDSH_1.0.0_x64-setup.exe` |
| **1.0.0** (latest) | macOS 1
2+ (Apple silicon) | `BioDSH_1.0.0_aarch64.dmg` |
- **Upgrading from 0.3.0:** installed 0.3.0 apps are not auto-updated to 1.0; install 1.0.0 over it
when you are ready. Your projects, files and conversations are never deleted, but conversations reco

rded with 0.3.0 may not open in 1.0.
- **Windows:** on first run, click *More info → Run anyway*. Th

e installer is not code-signed.
- **macOS:** the app is not notarized, so macOS may report it as "da
maged". Move it to Applications and run `sudo xattr -cr /Applications/BioDSH.app` once.
The stable app checks for updates in the background and installs them with one click. Updates are si
gnature-verified, and the app sends no data when it checks.
## Use it inside DeepSeek Harness
If you already use dsh, you can install the BioDSH agent as a plugin without the desktop app:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
You can also install it from the dsh web UI: **Plugins → Install → `dsh-biodsh`**. Restart dsh, then
pick **BioDSH** in the agent preset menu. Your other presets are left unchanged. The plugin require
s dsh 0.2.1+ and pnpm. For details, see `packages/dsh-biodsh`.
If you only want the skills, the official skills are plain dsh `SKILL.md` folders. `./scripts/instal
l-into-dsh.sh <your-project>/.agents/skills` copies them in (use `install-into-dsh.ps1` on Windows).
## Results
From our preprint (*arXiv link coming*). The benchmark is BioDSH-Bench-120: 120 analysis tasks in 10
subdomains, graded by replaying each submitted script against a public table contract, with no LLM
judge. Every agent runs in the same read-isolated sandbox, one run per configuration.
**Same model, different agent: a tie.** With every agent on DeepSeek V4 Flash:
| Agent (DeepSeek V4 Flash) | Correct / 120 |

| BioDSH + blind second analysis | 102 |
| DeepSeek Harness without BioDSH | 101 |
| BioDSH | 98 |
|

Codex CLI | 98 |
| Claude Code | 96 |
No pairwise difference is statistically significant.
**The model matters more than the agent.** With their own models, Codex ranges from 76 to 116 and Cl
aude Code from 95 to 103. On BixBench-Verified-50, run behind a network allow-list, all four agents
95 to 103. On BixBench-Verified-50, run behind a network allow-list, all four agents score 33–34/50.
What BioDSH adds is therefore not accuracy on the same model but the environment around it: a deskto
p app, vetted skills, isolated and auditable runs, and a choice of local or remote models.
**A note on benchmark contamination.** Coding agents read whatever files they can reach and look ans
wers up online, and several widely shared community skills ship benchmark answers. BioDSH's skill li
brary is scanned for this, and the contaminated skills we found are excluded (`dsh-biodsh` 1.0.0-pre
or this, and the contaminated skills we found are excluded (`dsh-biodsh` 1.0.0-preview.2 and later).
## Build from source
You need Node.js 22+, stable Rust and the Tauri prerequisites.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
| Path | Contents |
| `desktop/` | The desktop app: React UI (`src/`), Rust backend (`src-tauri/`) and build scripts. |
| `packages/dsh-biodsh/` | The `dsh-biodsh` plugin: BioDSH presets, skill selection and the converge

nce guard. |
| `biodsh-core/skills/` | Official skills. |
